title: Loft Rise of Virtual Missions Poster
summary: A poster translating Loft's satellite edge-computing concept into a clear visual story.
overview: Through Forge HQ, I designed the Rise of Virtual Missions poster for Loft. The work used a bold, direct visual treatment to explain how virtual missions can turn satellites into edge-computing platforms without new hardware.

projectBrief.context: Loft needed to communicate a satellite and edge-computing concept to a technical audience.
projectBrief.challenge: The idea had to be understandable in a single poster without flattening the technical premise.
projectBrief.contribution: Through Forge HQ, I designed the Rise of Virtual Missions poster and its visual treatment.
projectBrief.approach: I reduced the message to one clear idea, then used bold typography and a focused composition to make the technical story easier to scan.
projectBrief.outcome: The final poster gave Loft a concise visual explanation of virtual missions and satellite-based edge computing.
